card.name: Punctuation inside warning-list passages
card.fires_on: Commas and small linking words inside two memorized warning passages: the NMS differential diagnosis list (toxicity, heat stroke, drug fever) and the corticosteroid caution list (perforation, abscess, latent peptic ulcer).
